sentences.text: Duffinselache was a basal shark belonging to the class Chondrichthyes and the parent group Neoselachii.
This extinct basal shark, known as Duffin's shark, is represented by a single species found in the Late Triassic of England.
Duffin first named the animal in 1998, initially classifying it as a species of Polyacrodus.
In 2012, researchers Plamen S. Andreev and Gilles Cuny moved the species to a new genus, designating it the type species of Duffinselache.
This animal lived during the Rhaetian stage, between 205.7 and 201.4 million years ago.
